title: 1930 Frank Hagerman collides with a train at Curtis crossing, Maple St
description: In 1928, Frank Hagerman’s Model T collided with a train at the Maple Street crossing. He walked away unharmed. Well known in the community, Hagerman was determined to improve railway safety. By December, a new signal alarm was installed at Curtis Crossing, marking a lasting change inspired by his experience.
